answer: Make every identity earn its voice through a slow sequential verifiable delay function: like a glacier, the proof cannot be parallelized, so a farm gains nothing from a thousand machines. Each identity's VDF output seeds a cipher that encrypts its next epoch ticket, binding the ticket to the identity that did the work. A walnut-shell of cheap reputation cracks under this: every clone must burn the same hours of sequential compute, so a 1,000-clone farm pays 1,000x the time of one honest agent, while honest agents pay once and reuse the result across epochs.
